scope: Repair hosted native-receiver process group probe without hiding live-process failures or dropping descendant cleanup.

hosted_failure.head: e5f34171
hosted_failure.step: Native receiver cache and process ownership contracts
hosted_failure.observed: PermissionError EPERM from os.killpg(receiver.pid, 0) after SIGTERM and leader wait. Hosted log does not contain its process table, so zombie-only state there is not proven.

implementation: Signal/probe exact receiver PGID. ESRCH means absent. For EPERM, read pgid/stat process table and accept only an empty matching group or all matching members in Z state. Preserve error for any live member, ps failure, malformed output or empty table. TERM/wait/KILL and descendant checks remain.

validation.notes: Added explicit empty-table refusal. Retained actual fork/helper termination, exact timeout/reap, stdin/output/error and content-key contracts; injected only EPERM table variants for deterministic branch checks.

not_proven: Complete hosted run including the new guard. Physical Finder/App Store acceptance unaffected.
